Ships

Owner: Lucía Ferrer (Game Designer). Prototypes: Mei Tanaka.

The player chooses one ship at the start of a run and keeps it until the run ends. Each ship has its own speed, main shot and hitbox; all ships share the same special weapons and items.

Prototypes and Concept Art

The Miro board holds the prototypes (top row: silhouette, hitbox and role of each ship; edit them there) and, below each prototype, a display copy of the ship's approved concept image.

https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVEUtjxFw=/

Concept Art

The concept art is generated and kept in Scenario, which is the source of the images (see AI-Assisted Development). The images in the Miro board are display copies; this table is the record of which image is approved. Click an ID to open the original in Scenario (members of the team's Scenario workspace only), or fetch it through the Scenario MCP server with that ID.

Design Notes

  • Kestrel is the default selection and the ship used in the first playable milestone.

  • Halberd is the only ship that deals full damage to armored enemies (Bulwark) with its main shot.

  • Wisp rewards dodging: its needles find targets, so the player can focus on movement.

  • The hitbox is a circle at the cockpit, drawn as a visible dot while the focus button is held.

  • In-game sprites are 48 x 48 pixels; the prototypes are silhouettes, not final art.
